input.quote: Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory to (i) reproduce the Software in machine executable object code format only for installation on the Corio Servers;
input.rationale: The grant is perpetual and irrevocable (2.1) and the internal-use licence is fully paid up and perpetual (2.2), so revocability is not an issue, and Section 14.1 permits assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, which satisfies the fallback on transferability. However, neither Section 2 nor the definitions mention affiliates or contractors ("Affiliate" appears nowhere in the Agreement), and there is no mechanism to add them, so the clause fails the fallback requirement that affiliates be covered (at minimum on written notice). We therefore propose a new Section 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance. Note that "Corio Servers" covers servers "owned or operated by or for Corio", which only partially addresses contractor use.

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates and contractors acting on Corio's behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a provision extending the Section 2 licences to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our playbook requires the licence to cover affiliate and contractor use of the hosted Software. We are happy to fall back to affiliate coverage on written notice to Commerce One if preferred.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, provided that Corio remains responsible for their compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
